messages:
tara: Sharing a new compact roles grid prototype. Objective: reduce vertical space, surface SSO enforcement, make audit jumps discoverable. mock: https://img.redwood.test/ux/roles-grid-compact.png

tara: Proposed pieces: compact rows, per-user visibility toggle (All / SSO only / Pending), SSO status chip in header, inline SSO hint in invite drawer.

ben: Quick ask: persist the visibility toggle per user and don't mix with team filters. localStorage first.

tara: yep localStorage.

hui: Copy suggestion: header chip use 'SSO required' instead of 'enforced' (clearer for admins). tooltip: 'Members must sign in through your SSO provider.'

tara: updated text in mock.

eva: Invite drawer UX: prefer a subtle helper under email instead of banner. shows shield icon + helper: 'Org requires SSO. Invited users will sign in with SSO.' Link to docs.

hui: Accessibility: helper should be role="status" with aria-live="polite" for validation, and the shield must have aria-label.

tara: sample pattern posted.

ben: Audit log: add a right-rail 'Related actions' micro-panel linking to invites/role changes/SSO events to reduce navigation. open inline list instead of full page nav.

eva: Also add keyboard shortcut to open the filter (f) and cycle (arrow keys). Document in Shift+/.

tara: design-bot: color contrast check please for the SSO chip and badges.

ui-bot: Contrast check: amber #f2a84b on white = 3.2:1 (fail). Suggested #d97a20 or #b86b1a for AA small text.

eva: Good catch. Also ensure row truncation allows two-line wrap at 1280px. current single line ellipsis is too aggressive.

hui: QA checklist from a11y: chip aria-describedby, tooltip keyboard focus, aria-live on invite helper, contrast >=4.5, keyboard shortcuts discoverability.

tara: thanks team. I'll push updated mocks with contrast fixes, the admin override for external invites, and a short prototype for keyboard flows. Will post PR tomorrow.

eva: ping me for a11y pass.

ben: excited.

tara: (thread closed)
